timeline.description: Detonation. X-ray pulse heats the air to millions of degrees.
Prompt neutron/gamma pulse. Lethal radiation to 1.68 km (neutrons), 2.40 km (gamma).
Thermal flash. Temporary flash blindness to 13.3 km (day) / 174 km (night).
Fireball reaches maximum size (416 m radius). Surface ~10,000,000 °C.
Blast wave at 5 psi (3.30 km). Most buildings destroyed; ~160 mph winds.
Blast wave at 1 psi (10.2 km). Windows shatter into shrapnel.
Firestorm ignites within 564 m. Hurricane-force inward winds feed the fire.
Firestorm smoke lofting reaches the bounded cloud-top proxy at ~2.0 km; this is a source indicator for the qualitative climate narrative, not a climate forecast.
Mushroom cloud reaches ~2.0 km altitude.

timeline.description: Detonation. X-ray pulse heats the air to millions of degrees.
Prompt neutron/gamma pulse. Lethal radiation to 1.68 km (neutrons), 2.40 km (gamma).
Thermal flash. Temporary flash blindness to 13.3 km (day) / 174 km (night).
Fireball reaches maximum size (315 m radius). Surface ~10,000,000 °C.
Blast wave at 5 psi (2.64 km). Most buildings destroyed; ~160 mph winds.
Blast wave at 1 psi (8.17 km). Windows shatter into shrapnel.
Firestorm ignites within 564 m. Hurricane-force inward winds feed the fire.
Firestorm smoke lofting reaches the bounded cloud-top proxy at ~1.7 km; this is a source indicator for the qualitative climate narrative, not a climate forecast.
Mushroom cloud stabilizes at ~1.7 km. Fallout begins.
Heaviest fallout within 7.56 km downwind.
Light fallout extends 26.7 km downwind. 7:10 decay rule applies.
